stig.name: Google Chrome Current Windows Security Technical Implementation Guide

usage.intuneCustomProfile: Create an Intune Windows custom configuration profile and add each OMA-URI row. Prefer Settings Catalog when a native setting exists. ADMX-backed values may need SyncML <enabled/> payloads — see Learn links.
steps: Prefer Settings Catalog if the CSP is exposed there.
Else create a Windows Custom (OMA-URI) configuration profile.
Add each settings[] row: OMA-URI, type, value.
Assign to a pilot group; verify with STIG checks.
usage.disclaimer: Suggestions are assistive, not authoritative. Validate against STIG checks, organizational policy, and current Microsoft documentation. Mappings may be multi-option or incomplete.

readme:
stigref Intune pack — chrome
STIG: Google Chrome Current Windows Security Technical Implementation Guide V2R11

Contents:
  - This JSON file (policy settings + metadata)
  - settingsCsv field (copy into .csv)

How to use in Microsoft Intune:
  1. Prefer Settings Catalog when the setting exists there.
  2. Otherwise: Devices > Configuration > Create > Windows 10+ > Templates > Custom.
  3. Add each OMA-URI with the listed data type and value.
  4. ADMX-backed settings may need SyncML <enabled/> payloads — open Learn URLs.

Disclaimer: Assistive only. Validate against STIG checks and current Microsoft docs.
Policy CSP index: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/client-management/mdm/policy-configuration-service-provider

rulesSummary.title: Firewall traversal from remote host must be disabled.
Site tracking users location must be disabled.
Sites ability to show pop-ups must be disabled.
Extensions installation must be blocklisted by default.
Extensions that are approved for use must be allowlisted.
The default search providers name must be set.
The default search provider URL must be set to perform encrypted searches.
Default search provider must be enabled.
The Password Manager must be disabled.
Background processing must be disabled.
Google Data Synchronization must be disabled.
The URL protocol schema javascript must be disabled.
Cloud print sharing must be disabled.
Network prediction must be disabled.
Metrics reporting to Google must be disabled.
Search suggestions must be disabled.
Importing of saved passwords must be disabled.
Incognito mode must be disabled.
Online revocation checks must be performed.
Safe Browsing must be enabled.
Browser history must be saved.
The version of Google Chrome running on the system must be a supported version.
Deletion of browser history must be disabled.
Prompt for download location must be enabled.
Download restrictions must be configured.
Safe Browsing Extended Reporting must be disabled.
WebUSB must be disabled.
Google Cast must be disabled.
Autoplay must be disabled.
URLs must be allowlisted for Autoplay use.
Anonymized data collection must be disabled.
Collection of WebRTC event logs must be disabled.
Chrome development tools must be disabled.
Guest Mode must be disabled.
AutoFill for credit cards must be disabled.
AutoFill for addresses must be disabled.
Import AutoFill form data must be disabled.
Web Bluetooth API must be disabled.
Use of the QUIC protocol must be disabled.
Session only based cookies must be enabled.
Create Themes with AI must be disabled.
DevTools Generative AI features must be disabled.
GenAI local foundational model must be disabled.
Help Me Write must be disabled.
AI-powered History Search must be disabled.
Tab Compare Settings must be disabled.
